note: The IEOM's observatory of bank charges in the French Pacific (prices at 1 April 2026), its table of the territories' averages, Wallis and Futuna having one bank, the Banque de Wallis et Futuna: the yearly price, in CFP francs, of each bank's international deferred-debit card, whose month's spending the bank takes from the account at once, so nothing is carried on it. The banks' revolving credit isn't in the table and isn't kept. On 2026-10-30 the Banque de Wallis et Futuna's own site (bwf.wf) was tried for its price list and refused the connection; the IEOM table stays the source.
